en.text:
Firing or swinging the weapon grants a stack of Nadir Focus for 2 seconds. Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

Maximum number of Stacks by Weapon Type:
• Auto Rifles, Submachine Guns?: 11 stacks
• Sidearms, Swords: 5 stacks
• Hand Cannons, Scout Rifles: 4 stacks
• Grenade Launchers: ? stacks

Benefits scale linearly? with each stack, equalizing between Weapon Types at max stacks. (E.g.: you would gain 1/4 of the maximum benefit per stack with Hand Cannons)

Benefits at max Stacks:
• 10 Range
• 7.5%? decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 100%? increased Lunge Distance (Swords)
• ?% increased Projectile Velocity (Grenade Launchers)
